workstreams.name: Current state, two companies
workstreams.answers: How do sales, purchasing and finance run today at the first company and one other acquired company?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in each company
Walk through sales, purchasing and finance processes
Collect operational and cost data for each company

workstreams.name: Third company, gap ranking
workstreams.answers: How do sales, purchasing and finance run at the third company, and which gaps to Grupo Vale matter most?
activities: Interview staff and collect data at the third company
Compare all three companies with Grupo Vale's processes
Rank the gaps for the go/no-go on design

workstreams.name: Design, first two companies
workstreams.answers: How should the first company and one other move sales, purchasing and finance onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems?
activities: Detail target processes with each company's leaders
Map each company's processes onto Grupo Vale's systems
List the data and system changes each move needs

workstreams.name: Design, third company
workstreams.answers: How should the third company's sales, purchasing and finance move onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems?
activities: Apply design choices from the first two companies
Detail target processes with the company's leaders
Map the company's processes onto Grupo Vale's systems

workstreams.name: Integration plan and review
workstreams.answers: What integration plan for the three companies, with sequence and risks, can the board approve?
activities: Sequence the moves of the three companies and list risks
Set the readiness checks for the first company's cutover
Review designs and plan with the CEO, CFO and company heads

workstreams.name: Cutover, first two areas
workstreams.answers: Do two of the first company's sales, purchasing and finance areas run on Grupo Vale's processes and systems after cutover?
activities: Prepare the two areas for cutover with the process owners
Move the two areas onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems
Track live operating data against the cutover checks

workstreams.name: Cutover, third area
workstreams.answers: Does the last of the first company's sales, purchasing and finance areas run on Grupo Vale's processes and systems?
activities: Apply what the first two areas showed to the third area
Move the third area onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems
Track live results against the readiness checks

workstreams.name: Stabilization, plan update
workstreams.answers: Which open issues remain after cutover, and does the integration plan hold up against the first company's results?
activities: Close open issues with the people using the new processes
Test first-company results against the success criteria
Update the integration plan with what the cutover showed
